offending_extra_words: and all amounts due under this Agreement
reasons: All atomic elements of the preferred position are present: mutual cap, greater-of fee/USD 1,000,000 basis, mutual exclusion of indirect and consequential damages, the full uncapped carve-out list, and payment obligations excluded from 'damages'.
The fallback is not satisfied on its own terms because the cap is a greater-of construct rather than a cap of 12 months' fees; this is immaterial since the locked target is preferred.

Minimality fails: 'and all amounts due under this Agreement' broadens the payment-obligations exclusion beyond the playbook's Customer payment carve-out and operates bilaterally, potentially removing amounts owed to Client from the recovery calculus. The preferred position needed only Customer's payment obligations.

Intent preservation fails: the inserted text uses 'Customer's', which is undefined in this agreement (the party is 'Client'), creating a dangling reference that could be argued not to bind the parties as intended. Change to 'Client's payment obligations'.

Note (rationale only, not a deviation): the retained parenthetical '(OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT)' is now duplicative of the Excluded Claims definition and remains one-sided in wording, though the new definition cures the mutuality gap.
